content.value_statement: Security and privacy reviews can miss framework-specific gaps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured checks for OWASP, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, and secure coding.
actual_capabilities: Reviews code against OWASP Top 10 categories and secure coding checklists.
Maps findings to PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, CCPA, FERPA, NIST, and ISO 27001 contexts.
Produces gap analysis reports with severity, affected standard, evidence, and remediation phases.
Identifies examples of injection, broken access control, logging failures, weak crypto, and data handling issues.
Supports scoped prompts for standards such as OWASP, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and GDPR.
limitations: Does not provide legal advice or certification.
Requires access to relevant source code, configuration, policies, or evidence supplied by the user.
May miss issues that need runtime testing, architecture review, or organization records.
Regulation details can change; verify legal obligations with qualified professionals.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Application Security Review
use_cases.description: Review a repository against OWASP Top 10 and secure coding expectations before release.

use_cases.title: Check Privacy-Sensitive Workflows
use_cases.description: Find data handling gaps for healthcare, payment, education, or consumer privacy workflows.

use_cases.title: Plan Remediation Work
use_cases.description: Turn compliance gaps into prioritized fixes with owners, timelines, and evidence requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Run OWASP Baseline Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of common web risks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use compliance-checker to review this repository for OWASP Top 10 issues. Summarize risks by category and list concrete fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Check Privacy Data Handling
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for sensitive data flows.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review how this application collects, stores, logs, and deletes personal data. Map each concern to GDPR or CCPA where relevant.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Regulated Workflows
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for healthcare or payment systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this service for HIPAA and PCI-DSS gaps. Focus on authentication, audit logs, encryption, retention, and sensitive data exposure.

prompt_templates.title: Build Remediation Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare current controls against OWASP ASVS, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and GDPR. Create prioritized remediation phases with evidence needed for each gap.

output_examples.input: Review an API service for OWASP Top 10 compliance.
output: Highest risk: missing authorization checks on protected records.
Recommended fix: add ownership checks and deny access by default.
Evidence needed: route tests, access control policy, and audit logs.

output_examples.input: Assess a healthcare portal for HIPAA and GDPR readiness.
output: HIPAA status: several technical safeguards need evidence.
GDPR status: deletion and portability workflows need implementation proof.
Priority: remove protected health information from logs before release.

output_examples.input: Create a remediation plan for compliance gaps.
output: Phase 1: fix critical access control, logging, and encryption gaps.
Phase 2: add automated checks and policy evidence.
Phase 3: schedule recurring audits and update compliance documentation.

best_practices: Provide the exact standards, application scope, and risk tolerance before review.
Share representative code, configuration, logs, and policy evidence when available.
Validate legal and certification conclusions with qualified compliance professionals.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the report as a formal certification.
Do not hide critical systems, data flows, or third-party integrations from the review.
Do not apply generic checklist fixes without testing them in the target system.

faq.question: Can this skill certify compliance?
faq.answer: No. It can identify gaps and evidence needs, but certification requires qualified auditors and formal review.

faq.question: Which standards does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers OWASP, OWASP ASVS, CWE, SANS, NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, CCPA, and FERPA topics.

faq.question: Can it review a whole repository?
faq.answer: Yes, when used in a tool that can access repository files and when the user scopes the review clearly.

faq.question: Does it need production data?
faq.answer: No. Use source code, sanitized examples, architecture notes, and policy evidence instead of live sensitive data.

faq.question: How accurate are the findings?
faq.answer: Accuracy depends on available evidence. Runtime tests, logs, and architecture details improve the review.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
